name: source_select
description: Select source long-form video from library/downloaded list for clipping.
expected_output: List of DownloadedVideo objects with title, duration, aspect, path.
project_mutation: Adds source asset into document['assets'] and binds to project timeline.

name: source_preview
description: Playback and preview of selected source media in player.
project_mutation: Unified into Motion's single canonical player; no second preview player.

name: filmstrip_generate
description: Generate sampled filmstrip sprite sheet for timeline scrubbing.
project_mutation: Cached in data directory; referenced by timeline track rendering.

name: frame_extract
description: Extract exact video frame image at specified timestamp.
project_mutation: Used for hover preview and scrub frame inspection in canonical timeline.

name: speech_transcribe
description: Transcribe audio to timestamped words and sentences via Whisper.
expected_output: List of segments with start, end, text, words.
project_mutation: Recorded on project timeline captions track or document['transcripts'].

name: segments_cache
description: Retrieve cached word-level transcript segments for video.
expected_output: { segments: [{start, end, text, words}], cached: bool }
project_mutation: Zero retranscription if cached; reused directly in timeline.

name: suggest_clips_ai
description: Ask AI candidate highlight detection with virality scoring and hook ranker.
params: max_clips, min_duration, max_duration, platform, genre, user_query
expected_output: { job_id: str } -> suggestions: [{start, end, title, score, hook_score, hook_type, reason}]
project_mutation: Stores proposed clips into document['bench_ranges'] for review in timeline.

name: platform_bias
description: Biases hook ranking toward platform style (tiktok, youtube_shorts, reels, linkedin, twitter).
project_mutation: Embeds target_platform in project metadata and clip options.

name: genre_bias
description: Biases clip selection toward video genre (podcast, interview, tutorial, gaming, etc.).
project_mutation: Embeds genre in project metadata.

name: user_query_filter
description: Filters candidate clips by user natural-language focus (e.g. 'find the pricing debate').
project_mutation: Stored as query tag in project revision.

name: bench_range_set
description: Set, move, or resize in/out cut ranges on the timeline cutting bench.
error_codes: Validation error on overlap or duration < 5s
project_mutation: Updates document['bench_ranges'] with atomic CAS revision bump.

name: bench_range_snap
description: Snaps proposed cut boundaries to nearest sentence and speech unit boundaries.
expected_output: Adjusted windows aligned to sentence pauses without clipped words.
error_codes: Falls back to raw timestamps if no sentences found
project_mutation: Clips positioned precisely at clean speech boundaries.

name: bench_range_dedup
description: Enforces non-overlapping constraint: eliminates intersecting cut ranges.
project_mutation: Guarantees timeline clips do not collide or duplicate content.

name: bench_topic_dedup
description: Deduplicates candidate clips covering the exact same semantic topic/keyword set.
expected_output: Diverse candidate list with topic uniqueness.
project_mutation: Ensures varied output clips across long video.

name: extract_clips_ai
description: Extract top viral clips automatically via Whisper transcription and LLM picker.
expected_output: { job_id: str } -> List of GeneratedVideo records and physical MP4 files.
project_mutation: Populates canonical ProjectRevision tracks and produces export MP4s.

name: extract_clips_manual
description: Extract user-specified time ranges verbatim with post-processing.
params: time_ranges: list[{start, end}], caption_style, emoji_style, remove_silence, force_vertical
expected_output: { job_id: str } -> List of GeneratedVideo records and physical MP4 files.
project_mutation: Translates manual ranges directly to timeline clips on media track.

name: duration_fallback
description: Evenly slices video duration into deliverables when AI picker returns 0 candidates.
params: duration: float, max_clips: int, clip_duration: float = 60.0
expected_output: List of window slices with clip_selection='duration_fallback'.
project_mutation: Emits time slice clips flagged with duration_fallback in metadata.

name: silence_remove
description: Detects and cuts dead air / silent pauses > 0.5s and speech fillers.
expected_output: Cleaned media file without awkward dead pauses.
project_mutation: Updates clip duration and timing in project timeline.

name: segment_retime
description: Recalculates word and segment timestamps after audio chunks are cut.
expected_output: Retimed segments matching shortened media timeline.
project_mutation: Subtitles stay in 100% frame-perfect sync with edited media.

name: reframe_vertical
description: Transforms 16:9 landscape into 9:16 vertical using stacked background blur-fill.
expected_output: 1080x1920 MP4 file with sharp centered video and blurred backdrop.
project_mutation: Sets document['aspect_ratio'] = '9:16' and layout preset.

name: captions_burn
description: Burns synchronized ASS subtitles with word-level animation into MP4.
project_mutation: Captions represented as editable items on captions track.

name: captions_style
description: Applies typography presets: viral, standard, minimal, toktok, cinematic, beast, etc.
expected_output: ASS Style header with font, outline, shadow, color, margin.
project_mutation: Stores caption style and parameters on track.

name: emoji_density
description: Injects relevant animated emojis into captions based on spoken keywords.
project_mutation: Preserved in caption track item payload.

name: metadata_generate
description: Generates viral hook title, SEO description, and platform hashtags via LLM.
error_codes: Provider error falls back to default metadata
project_mutation: Saves metadata to project document and export attributes.

name: virality_score_breakdown
description: Calculates 5-factor scorecard: hook, flow, value, trend, shareability (1-10).
expected_output: { hook: float, flow: float, value: float, trend: float, shareability: float }
project_mutation: Saved in document['metadata']['virality_score_breakdown'].

name: thumbnail_generate
description: Extracts cover frame at hook peak (1.5s - 3.0s) for high CTR thumbnail.
project_mutation: Saved to asset storage and referenced in project document.

name: thumbnail_regenerate
description: Regenerate clip thumbnail at custom playhead timecode.
project_mutation: Bumps thumbnail cache-busting timestamp in project revision.

name: clip_metadata_edit
description: Update clip title, description, tags, virality score.
project_mutation: Atomic CAS mutation updating project metadata.

name: clip_stream
description: Stream rendered clip with HTTP Range support for scrub and seek.
project_mutation: Directly consumable by canonical Motion player.

name: clip_stream_aspect
description: Stream rendered clip for specific aspect (landscape vs portrait).
project_mutation: Consumable by canonical Motion player with aspect switcher.

name: clip_delete
description: Delete clip record and purge media/thumbnail files from disk safely.
project_mutation: Removes clip from timeline or archives project revision.

name: timeline_project_map
description: Maps extracted clip into Motion's single timeline, single player, single ProjectRevision.
expected_output: Updated ProjectRevision with populated video, audio, and subtitle tracks.
project_mutation: Bumps revision, inserts tracks, sets duration and aspect ratio.

name: project_reopen
description: Reopen saved project revision in Motion with 100% preservation of clips and tracks.
project_mutation: Deterministic deserialization of schema_version 2 document.

name: project_export_mp4
description: Render and export canonical project composition to physical MP4 decoded by FFprobe.
expected_output: Physical MP4 file with valid ffprobe audio/video streams.
project_mutation: Creates output deliverable record and writes MP4 to disk.
